decision: Node versus Deno for the TypeScript control plane
recommendationRationale: No hard fail on either arm; the weighted composite is inside the pre-registered 10% margin at 4.7%.
The peak-RSS tie-breaker favours Deno in all five runs, and Deno also wins cold start and single-binary packaging.
Node wins durable append throughput, event-loop p50, warm start, and worker startup; this is a near-tie, not a performance win.
conditions: Do not treat the result as a performance win; re-run after the ledger sequencer and worker model exist.

residuals: The composite margin is 1.5-4.7% across runs; a different worker or filesystem can flip it.
